description: Dated statutory exchange schedule FeeSchedule.exchange_presets() must equal, in rupees per crore of the row's base. Components are separate: exchange transaction charge, IPFT, SEBI turnover fee, transaction tax (STT/CTT, on the side shown), stamp duty (buy side). GST is 18% of exchange + IPFT + SEBI (IPFT included conservatively). `status` is `confirmed` where the figure is matched to an official circular or statute and `unverified` otherwise (a result lists the unverified rows it used). An unverified row whose source publishes no IPFT charges none; that is stated in its source, not defaulted silently. No brokerage and no depository charge. Dates are IST; a row applies from effective_from (inclusive) to effective_until (exclusive).
